judge: one agent per 11 packs, arm label not in the pack (rubric_v2.md)

P1.quote: each cell runs for about 50 s (15 s to set up the environment, 30 s of bootstrap), plus a verification rerun after it

P2.quote: both batches needed 2 fix commits for the hand-edited `subject` cell. `accuracy` had `ci: 90` and `"cvs"`; `cap_hit` had `ci: 99` and `digits: "3"`.

P3.quote: the verification rerun doubles each cell's time. It has repeated exactly every time, as it should with a fixed seed.

P5.quote: `bench-rng` runs again in every batch, and its numbers moved 30% between batches (56,000/s against 39,000/s).

other_claims: Cells launch serially: subject first, the other five only after it finished, so a batch takes about 6 minutes
The results folder and run.json are put together by hand for each batch
check_cell.py checks only one cell at a time
bench-rng timings moved 30% between batches (56,000/s against 39,000/s)
change_summary: Adds jobs/submit_batch.py, which checks every cell and that HEAD is pushed, launches submit.sh for all cells in parallel (rerun kept) and writes results/<batch>-NN/ with run.json; the README's How to run uses it.
